phrases.latin: Rēctā perge, Theodōre, ūsque ad portam.
phrases.english: Go straight on, Theo, as far as the gate.

phrases.latin: Rēctā perge per trēs vīcōs ūsque ad theātrum; dein tē verte dextrōrsum et prōcēde ūsque ad secundum compitum.
phrases.english: Go straight ahead for three blocks as far as the theatre; then turn right and go on to the second crossroads.

phrases.latin: īte hāc triumphī ad cantharum rēctā viā
phrases.english: this way, triumphal procession, straight to the wine jug

sources: Lewis & Short: rectus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 173, 386.
